scripts.empaquetar:produccion: pnpm build && uv run python scripts/empaquetar_produccion.py
scripts.dev:stack: pnpm preparar:config && pnpm build && uv run python scripts/iniciar_stack_desarrollo.py
scripts.format: prettier --write '.github/**/*.yml' 'apps/**/*.{ts,vue,css,json,mjs}' 'packages/**/*.{ts,vue,json}' 'scripts/**/*.mjs' 'tests/**/*.{ts,json}' playwright.config.ts playwright.integrado.config.ts vitest.config.mjs package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md tools/device-simulator/README.md config/README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check '.github/**/*.yml' 'apps/**/*.{ts,vue,css,json,mjs}' 'packages/**/*.{ts,vue,json}' 'scripts/**/*.mjs' 'tests/**/*.{ts,json}' playwright.config.ts playwright.integrado.config.ts vitest.config.mjs package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md tools/device-simulator/README.md config/README.md
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @sis-leg/moderacion lint && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/recinto lint && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/simulador lint && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/tecnico lint
scripts.postinstall: pnpm --filter @sis-leg/moderacion prepare && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/recinto prepare && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/simulador prepare && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/tecnico prepare
scripts.test: vitest run && vitest run --config apps/recinto/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config apps/simulador/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config apps/tecnico/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:integrado: pnpm preparar:config && pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.integrado.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @sis-leg/api-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/moderacion typecheck && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/recinto typecheck && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/simulador typecheck && pnpm --filter @sis-leg/tecnico typecheck
